loader_handoff.basis: Declared discovery input: a loader handoff in a free RAM gap (between section 2, ending 0x780330, and the section table at 0x950000), not a capture. The kernel copies 0x5c0 bytes from it. Word 0 bit 2 is set because the application powers down when boot reason 2 or 3 lacks it (0xc6ff14 via 0xc4da70(2)); the boot-reason word at +0x140 reads zero, which decodes to reason 3. Kernel entry bypasses the boot ROM.

flash_aperture.basis: Declared discovery input: the update image from its flash offset; bytes past it read erased. No flash capture exists.
